how_to_use: Paste CHARACTER_1 into Gemini as an image prompt. Save the image as buyer_sheet.png.
Paste CHARACTER_2 into Gemini as an image prompt. Save the image as seller_sheet.png.
For every video clip, attach the matching sheet and start the prompt with: Use the man from the attached reference image, same face, same hair, same clothes.
Keep the same seed if you need to regenerate a sheet with one field changed.

CHARACTER_1_BUYER.user_intent: character reference sheet of one ordinary American house buyer, for reuse as a reference image in video generation

composition.layout: character reference sheet, one row of four full-body views of the SAME man, evenly spaced, left to right
composition.consistency_rule: identical face, hair, clothing, body shape and lighting in all four views
composition.background: flat neutral light gray studio backdrop, no props, no furniture
composition.spacing: full body visible head to boots in every view, small even gap between views

subject.description: 38 year old American man, working class, stocky solid build, 5 foot 10, slight belly, broad shoulders, round friendly face, short neck

face.skin: fair skin with real texture: visible pores, sun damage on the nose and cheeks, faint acne scars on the jawline, a small mole near the right eyebrow, mild forehead shine
face.facial_hair: three days of uneven dark stubble with a few gray hairs on the chin
face.eyes: hazel, slightly hooded, crow's feet at the corners, light under-eye circles
face.nose: slightly wide, small bump on the bridge
face.mouth: relaxed half smile, slightly chapped lips, small gap between the front teeth
face.expression: friendly, easy going, a little cheeky

hair.style: short back and sides, a little longer and messy on top, slight cowlick at the crown
hair.color: dark brown with a few gray hairs at the temples

clothing.detail: no logo, no text, small bleach spot near the hem, soft collar
drywall dust on the knees, worn hems
cheap, scratched face, worn on the left wrist

subject.body_details: tanned forearms with a clear farmer tan line at the sleeve, short clean fingernails, a small old scar on the back of the right hand
subject.pose: standing straight and relaxed, arms at his sides, weight slightly on one leg

lighting.type: soft even daylight balanced studio light
lighting.note: flat and even so the face reads clearly in every view, no dramatic shadows, no glamour lighting

technical.film_stock: none, plain digital capture, natural color

CHARACTER_1_BUYER.colorRestriction: natural everyday colors: faded navy, mid blue denim, brown leather, neutral gray background, real skin tones, nothing saturated
